$comment: Seed defaults tuned for FULL AUTO MODE (see CLAUDE.md → 'Auto mode & permissions'). Two tiers only: allow = everything runs silently — file edits, project-root commands, and ALL VCS operations including merge/rebase/push (the project-root boundary itself is enforced by every agent's hard-boundary rule, since Bash rules cannot be path-scoped); deny = standard dangerous commands (sudo, destructive system ops, rm -rf on / or ~, force-push), never to be worked around — a hit is reported as a blocker. There is NO ask tier: nothing prompts the user. Deny wins over allow. /new-project keeps this structure and swaps stack-specific entries.
